observations: Photo 0: Front view of a smartphone with a notch, displaying iOS home screen with standard apps. The phone is held in a hand, showing a dark blue or black frame. The screen is on and responsive.

Photo 1: Back view of the same phone, showing a triple-camera module in a square bump, typical of iPhone 13/14 series. A white label with barcodes and text is affixed to the back. A pink sticker is also visible. The phone appears to be dark blue or black.

Photo 2: Front view of the phone showing the Settings menu, with options like Bluetooth, Cellular, Battery, General, etc. The 'Cellular' option is visible, indicating the phone is running iOS and has cellular settings, though the seller claims it is 'wifi only'.
All photos have a watermark 'DEETECH GADGETZ' and 'POSTED ON JIJI'.
No visible damage to the screen or back in the photos. The phone appears to be powered on and functional in the displayed screens.

read_from: photo 0 screen (iOS interface and notch design)
photo 1 back (triple-camera module and design consistent with iPhone 14)

claims.evidence: The model is visually consistent with iPhone 14 (photos 0 and 1), but the storage capacity (128GB) is not visible in any photo. The label in photo 1 is too blurry to read the storage info.

Photo 2 shows the 'Cellular' option in the Settings menu, which is present on unlocked or carrier-locked phones. The presence of this menu does not confirm network lock, but the claim 'wifi only' is contradicted by the existence of cellular settings. A true 'wifi only' model (like an iPad) would not have this option.

The term '100BH' is not defined in the photos. It may refer to battery health, but no battery health percentage is visible. The battery icon in photo 0 shows a full charge, but not health. Without a screenshot of battery health or a diagnostic tool, this claim cannot be verified remotely.

risks.risk: The phone may be stolen or have an active iCloud lock (Find My disabled)
risks.proof: A screenshot of the Settings > General > About > Serial Number and IMEI, and a check of the Apple website for activation status. Also, a screenshot of the 'Find My' status in Settings.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially locked or stolen, which reduces value significantly

risks.risk: The phone may have a cracked screen or back glass not visible in the photos
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the screen and back under direct light, showing any cracks, scratches, or damage.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having potential hidden damage, which reduces value

risks.risk: The storage capacity may not be 128GB as claimed
risks.proof: A screenshot of Settings > General > iPhone Storage, showing the total capacity.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unknown storage, which may be less than 128GB, reducing value

risks.risk: The phone may be a refurbished or non-genuine unit
risks.proof: A clear photo of the label in photo 1 showing the model number, serial number, and storage capacity. Also, a screenshot of the device info in Settings.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially non-genuine or refurbished, which reduces value
